title: Dan Campbell: I thought we'd get fourth-and-1, if not I knew we'd get the ball back

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: I thought we'd get fourth-and-1, if not I knew we'd get the ball back
sources.description: Dan Campbell made the most Dan Campbell-like decision he could make on Sunday when the Lions faced fourth-and-1 at their own 24-yard line with the score tied and 4:53 remaining in the fourth quarter: He went for it.
